description: Screen SEC filings across all companies with company-level filters (sector, industry, market cap, exchange) combined with filing-level filters (form type, date range). Returns filings enriched with company metadata: ticker, sector, industry, exchange, market cap, and price. Answers questions like "all S-1 filings from biotech companies under $500M market cap" or "recent 8-K filings from Technology sector companies". Results are filings, not a company universe or a company count. Only the 500 largest matching companies by market cap are searched (narrower filters reach smaller ones). Filters for float, price, company type, foreign issuer, recent IPO, full-text queries and 8-K item codes are not available here. Coverage: Signal8's SEC EDGAR archive, updated through the day, in its held range (see `archiveFrom` in each response; currently from late 2021, expanding back to 2016 as the history backfill fills in). Before archiveFrom it holds only a scatter, so absence before archiveFrom is not evidence a filing was never filed; SEC EDGAR itself covers earlier periods. Record-only rows (bodyStored: false) have no stored body; the document is at its sec.gov URL.

industry.description: Filter by industry (e.g., "Biotechnology", "Software - Application", "Oil & Gas E&P")

maxMarketCap.description: Maximum market cap in USD (e.g., 500000000 for $500M)

minMarketCap.description: Minimum market cap in USD (e.g., 1000000000 for $1B)

sortBy.description: Sort results by field (default: filing_date). Ties are broken by filing id, so a given page is stable and reproducible for a fixed corpus.

sortOrder.description: Sort direction (default: desc). Note that paging is offset-based over a corpus that is continuously ingesting new filings, so when walking many pages of a broad date range, newly-arrived filings can shift rows between pages; page on a closed dateFrom/dateTo window if you need an exhaustive, non-overlapping traversal.
